course_name_en: IGENI-EC0872GI - IS and business process modeling [IGENI-EC0872GI]

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the general functioning of a business information system.
Propose an information system architecture by integrating interoperability needs.
Model complex business processes with different formalisms.
Analyze, define and frame the evolution of information systems according to the business strategy, business processes and technological innovations.

Provide a consolidated view of the IS and to propose a coherent plan to align infrastructure, applications, IT solutions, functional modeling, business needs and business strategy, while considering the existing.

syllabus_topics: Chapter 1: Analysis and Design of Information Systems
Understanding and applying the MERISE approach
